import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])  # n is read but not used
    s = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ""

    max_outside = 0
    inside_count = 0
    cur = 0
    inside = False

    for ch in s:
        if ch == '(':
            if cur > max_outside:
                max_outside = cur
            cur = 0
            inside = True
        elif ch == ')':
            inside = False
            if cur > 0:
                inside_count += 1
                cur = 0
        elif ch == '_':
            if inside:
                if cur > 0:
                    inside_count += 1
            else:
                if cur > max_outside:
                    max_outside = cur
            cur = 0
        else:
            cur += 1

    if cur > max_outside:
        max_outside = cur

    print(f"{max_outside} {inside_count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
